8.4.5 J1939Nm_NetworkRelease
[SWS_J1939Nm_00045] Definition of API function J1939Nm_NetworkRelease
Upstream requirements: SRS_J1939_00036
⌈
Service Name
J1939Nm_NetworkRelease
Syntax
Std_ReturnType J1939Nm_NetworkRelease (
NetworkHandleType nmChannelHandle
)
Service ID [hex]
0x06
Sync/Async
Asynchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant (but not for the same NM-Channel)
Parameters (in)
nmChannelHandle
Identification of the NM-channel
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: No error
E_NOT_OK: Releasing of network has failed
Description
Release the network, since ECU doesn’t have to communicate on the bus.
Available via
J1939Nm.h
⌋
See Chapter 7.3.3 for details.
See Chapter 7.2.1 for error handling and Chapter 8.1 for parameter checks.
